rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “current” means existing or happening now.

example.english: The current weather is really hot.
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 ge3 tin1 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 jit6

rows.note: Pick this when “current” means popular or prevalent at the moment.

example.english: This style is very current this year.
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 cyun1 daap3 gam1 nin4 hou2 lau4 hang4

rows.note: Pick this for a currently accepted or commonly used practice, method, or usage.

example.english: Electronic payment has become the current standard practice.
example.traditional: 電子付款已經成為通行做法。
example.jyutping: din6 zi2 fu6 fun2 ji5 ging1 sing4 wai4 tung1 hang4 zou6 faat3

rows.note: Pick this for a rule, policy, or system that is currently in force.

example.english: The current regulations ban smoking indoors.
example.traditional: 現行條例禁止室內吸煙。
example.jyutping: jin6 hang4 tiu4 lai6 gam3 zi2 sat1 noi6 kap1 jin1
